Hi Sanjay / EdgeScale procurement team,

Thanks again for the deep dive this morning. Attached is the private-offer proposal we discussed for the mid-market bundle (seat license + metered inference units) and an initial channel margin workback for your reseller partner. Key points:

- List price for seat: $120/user/month (annual commit).
- Metered inference: $0.005 per inference-unit with a 10% volume discount at > 10M units/month.
- Reseller commission we proposed: 15% of net revenue (post-discount) paid monthly.

I flagged two asks where we'd like EdgeScale confirmation before we finalize the PO:
1) Do you require the reseller commission to be carved as a standalone line-item on the invoice (vs. passback via marketplace)?
2) If the solution is listed on Azure Marketplace for resale, would EdgeScale take marketplace passback or prefer distributor-managed commissions?

Attached: 20270112-az-privoffer-proposal.pdf (proposal) and channel-margin-workback.xlsx (spreadsheet).

If useful I can loop in our channel ops lead to map invoice paths. Available for a quick 30-min call tomorrow.

Thanks,

Ben — thanks for the proposal and the clear breakdown. A couple quick clarifications from procurement: 

- EdgeScale prefers commissions reflected as a marketplace passback where possible for visibility into CAF/reseller margining. That said, some enterprise distributors require carve-outs on the invoice. We'll confirm which path our reseller needs.
- For the seat + metered hybrid, finance wants to understand how overage credits are handled if monthly metered consumption spikes above committed bucket. Can you confirm your overage protection / lookback policy?

We'll aim to get a short internal note back by EOD tomorrow. If you can provide a one-line summary of the invoice path options (marketplace passback vs. reseller-invoice carve-out) that would speed approvals.

Folks — forwarding the EdgeScale note. Procurement asked two things: marketplace passback vs invoice carve-out, and overage protection. Quick suggested responses below — please review/edit before I send: 

Suggested one-line for invoice path: 
- "We support both marketplace passback (recommended for automated reconciliation and visibility) and reseller invoice carve-outs for distributors that require direct billing; Redwood will configure the invoice routing as part of the private-offer setup to match EdgeScale's reseller model."

Overage/lookback policy (short):
- "For metered consumption above the committed bucket, we offer a 30-day consumption lookback with a capped overage discount: customers are billed at the metered rate for excess tokens, but Redwood will provide a one-time reconciliation credit (up to 20% of the month’s metered spend) if monthly consumption exceeds the projected commit by more than 40% to avoid bill shock during early ramp."

Margin math notes (from the attached workbook):
- At list rates above, 15% commission nets ~12.75% on net revenue after a standard 5% marketplace fee. If EdgeScale needs a 20% reseller margin, we'd need to increase list price or move to a 5% commission + $X per-seat supplementation.

Laura — can you confirm whether legal needs a different phrasing for the overage credit? Ben — if you want, I can send the one-line invoice path + the overage policy to Sanjay now.

Thanks,
Ava
